sentences.en: Juliet talked to Romeo on the balcony, who was outside.
sentences.zh: 朱丽叶在阳台上和罗密欧说话，而他在外面。

sentences.en: Have you ever pegged your clothes up on the balcony?
sentences.zh: 你曾经把衣服晾在阳台上吗？

sentences.en: It's unthinkable that you would sunbathe, naked, on this balcony.
sentences.zh: 你竟然会在阳台上光着身子晒太阳，这真是难以想象。

senses.zh: 阳台,（电影院等的）楼厅，楼座,包厢
